text: Seabrook Town launches a quick counter-attack from their defensive left area, starting with Aiden Quinlan intercepting the ball. The ball swiftly travels long to Kian Adeyemi near the halfway line on the left flank, who advances into the attacking third on the left side. Kian passes short to Tariq Marlowe, positioned centrally just outside the penalty area. Tariq threads a precise through ball forward to Callum Varga, who is about 9 metres from Harbour City’s goal on the left side. Callum takes the ball past a defender and shoots with his foot, sending it into the net to tie the game 2-2 at the 69th minute[#1442] [#1443] [#1444] [#1445] [#1446] [#1447] [#1448].
